questions.hypothesis:
To list your sources using **APA 7th edition** style, format your **References** section according to the following guidelines:

### General Formatting
* **New Page & Heading:** Start the reference list on a new page at the end of your document. Center and bold the title **References** at the top.
* **Alphabetical Order:** Alphabetize all entries by the first author's last name (or by title if there is no author).
* **Indentation:** Apply a hanging indent of 0.5 inches to each reference entry (the first line is flush left, and subsequent lines are indented).
* **Spacing:** Double-space all reference entries throughout the entire list.

---

### Common Reference Formats

* **Book:**  
  Author, A. A. (Year). *Title of book*. Publisher.  
  *Example:* Smith, J. D. (2020). *Understanding media representation*. Academic Press.

* **Journal Article:**  
  Author, A. A., & Author, B. B. (Year). Title of article. *Title of Periodical*, *Volume*(Issue), Page range. https://doi.org/xxxx  
  *Example:* Smith, J. (2020). Gender representation in Caribbean cinema. *Journal of Film Studies*, *12*(3), 45–60.

* **Online Document / Webpage:**  
  Author, A. A. (Year, Month Day). *Title of webpage*. Website Name. URL
